title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
snippet: Bytedance Seed has introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model built for professional production workflows. title: Menlo: Agents Now Drive 80% of Enterprise AI Usage
snippet: Enterprise AI spending has surged to $177 billion, up from $33 billion in 2025, according to Menlo Ventures’ latest State of Enterprise AI report. Partner Deedy Das says AI agents now account for 80% of usage, as businesses move beyond chatbots toward systems capable of completing complex tasks autonomously. He also discusses the dominance of Anthropic and OpenAI in enterprise API spending. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Investor: Governance Now Part of the Valuation
snippet: Wealth Enhancement CIO Doug Huber says the fundamental investment case for Nvidia hasn’t changed, but the investigation surrounding CEO Jensen Huang is putting leadership, succession and corporate governance more firmly into the valuation debate. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nominal Bets on AI for Aerospace and Defense
snippet: Nominal has raised new funding at a $3 billion valuation as it builds an AI and data platform for hardware engineering. CEO and cofounder Cameron McCord says revenue has grown more than 3.5-fold in eight months, with customers including five of the world’s seven largest aerospace and defense companies. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia CEO Affair Draws Washington Scrutiny

Plus, Menlo Ventures is out with a new report on the state of enterprise AI. (Source: Bloomberg)
